title: Standing of a Signed Pre-Buy Request and the Share It Allows
content:
A signed pre-buy request lodged against an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts does not hold its full weight for ever. How long it has stood registered with the energy desk, taken with how busy the account has been over the year, fixes the share it allows.

1. Where the signed request has stood registered for at least 9 months and 3 or more stops were made on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date, the share the request's standing allows is 0.9 of it.
2. Where the request has stood registered for at least 9 months and fewer than 3 stops were made in that window, the share the request's standing allows is 0.5 of it.
3. Where the request has stood registered for fewer than 9 months, the share the request's standing allows is the whole of it.

## The three lines

| Whole months the signed request has stood registered | Stops made on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date | Share the request's standing allows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 9 or more | 3 or more | 0.9 |
| 9 or more | Fewer than 3 | 0.5 |
| Fewer than 9 | Either way | The whole of it |

The months are counted from the day the request was lodged to the handling date, and the test is met at 9 months exactly.

*Hypothetical.* A request lodged 10 months before the handling date on an account with 4 stops in the year allows 0.9 of the figure it is applied to: on 2000.0 gallons that is 1800.00 gallons. The same request on an account with 2 stops in the year allows 0.5, coming to 1000.00 gallons. A request lodged 8 months before the handling date allows the whole 2000.00 gallons on either account.
